prompt: curl upload-file stdin non-blocking mode filename
answer:
Use `.` (a single period) with `-T/--upload-file` to read stdin in non-blocking mode:

```bash
command | curl -T . ftp://user:password@example.com/filename.txt
```

`-` also reads from stdin, but `.` enables non-blocking stdin reading so curl can read server output while uploading. To set a multipart upload filename, use:

```bash
command | curl -F "file=@-;filename=filename.txt" https://example.com/upload
```
